## Context / Problem
`rebar workflow edit` (parser `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/workflow.py:73-78`, handler `src/rebar/_cli/_workflow_commands.py:115-116,123-151`) serves a bpmn-js editor from a 2 MB vendored bundle force-included in the wheel (`pyproject.toml:370-373`). ADR 0071 (Proposed) was never implemented. The editor drags a Node 22 toolchain into CI (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:585-622,629-653`), a `make e2e-deps` target (`Makefile:562-585`), and ~7,000 lines of editor-only Python/JS/tests. Operator decision (2026-09-06): remove it entirely; the engine and `workflow new|validate|run|show|status|result` stay. Cites re-verified on origin/main b97d414b8e2.

## Approach
Delete editor-only modules and assets; leave the engine untouched. `prompt_library.py` is the sole surviving importer of `prompt_authoring.py` (lazy imports at `prompt_library.py:185,254`), so inline its two helpers there (`_SLUG` `prompt_authoring.py:50`, `_valid_id` `:65-66`, `_atomic_write` `:228-239` wrapping `rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write`) instead of a new sub-100-LOC module, which module-size policy forbids. Remove the `REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT` resolver (`src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:346-358`) with its re-exports (`_config_sources.py:41`, `config.py:82`) and its seam-test entry. Regenerate CLI help/reference/env docs with their generators, never by hand.

KEEP (live non-editor callers): `lint.py`, `lint_refs.py`, `lint_expr.py`, `step_contracts.py`, `render.py`, `errors.WorkflowAssetsUnavailableError` (`llm/errors.py:228`; pinned by `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py`), `hatch_build.py`, the `ui` extra. REMOVE: `editor_contracts.py` (only `editor.py`/`editor_server.py` import it), `criterion_preview.py` (callers `editor_server.py`, `scripts/t5c_calibrate.py`, plus the static owned-file entry `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py:53`), `rebar.moddle.json` (only `test_bpmn.py`). CodeQL keeps `javascript` (`codeql.yml:49`, 7 JS files under `infra/terraform/auth/`); only the `:47` comment changes.

## Scope
Delete (git rm): `src/rebar/llm/workflow/{editor.py,editor_server.py,editor_contracts.py,bpmn.py,criterion_preview.py,prompt_authoring.py,rebar.moddle.json}`; `src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/`; `tests/e2e/`; `tests/unit/workflow/test_{bpmn,editor,editor_batch,editor_effective_policy,editor_roundtrip,editor_validate,prompt_authoring}.py`; `tests/unit/test_criterion_preview.py`; `tests/unit/test_browser_tier_optout.py`; `scripts/t5c_calibrate.py`.

Relocated helpers keep their oracle in `tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py` (invalid-id, uppercase-id, and `os.replace` atomicity tests). Removal is proven by absence (parse error, `ModuleNotFoundError`, wheel listing). `make verify` is the CI-equivalent gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rebar workflow edit x.yaml; echo $?` prints a usage error naming `{new,validate,run,show,status,result}` and exits non-zero; `rebar workflow --help` does not contain `edit`.
- [ ] `python -c "import rebar.llm.workflow as w; print('bpmn_to_ir' in w.__all__)"` prints `False`; `python -c "import rebar.llm.workflow.editor"` exits 1 with `ModuleNotFoundError`.
- [ ] `git ls-files src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets tests/e2e | wc -l` prints `0`; `python -m build --wheel && unzip -l dist/*.whl | grep -c editor_assets` prints `0`.
- [ ] `git grep -n -E 'e2e-deps|setup-node|editor_assets|REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT|prompt_authoring|criterion_preview' -- Makefile .github pyproject.toml src scripts tests ':!tests/fixtures'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check && python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check && python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` exit 0; `grep -c REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT docs/env-vars.md` prints `0`.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar.llm.prompting.prompt_library import _valid_id,_atomic_write; print(_valid_id('plan-review-G1G2'), _valid_id('a/b'))"` prints `True False`; `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py -q` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check && python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exit 0 reporting `new=0 increased=0`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; the Gerrit change reaches `Verified +1` with no Node setup step in its run log.
